findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Test
Case: normal use - A workflow edit changes the plugin path filter.
The proof still does not check effective admission for matching and nonmatching paths. It extracts list entries without checking whether the key is `paths` or `paths-ignore`, so changing that key reverses GitHub's behavior while the assertions still pass; plugin-only pull requests would skip the job. Also, line 48 uses [Python's `fnmatchcase`](https://docs.python.org/3.11/library/fnmatch.html), where `*` matches `/`, unlike [GitHub's path filters](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/workflows-and-actions/workflow-syntax#filter-pattern-cheat-sheet). Changing `src/forge/mod/**` to `src/forge/mod/*` would pass the test but skip nested plugin files. The previously requested admission proof remains incomplete.
